description: Get the full public record for one result id from search_results: provenance, every sample with its lot and analyses, every analyte measurement with its status, LOQ where known, and Laboratory.love’s per-serving exposure ratings with their assumptions. When answering: name the source (commissioned vs PlasticList-derived), keep detected / below_limit_of_quantitation / not_detected / not_tested distinct, give sample counts, and do not call a product safe because values are low or not detected. Read-only.
name: get_result
title: Get one test result
